chunks: Or do they have lords of their own besides Us who can defend them? But they are not able to help themselves, nor can they find protection against Us.
ai.seo_question: What is the weakness of false gods according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the logical absurdity of idolatry by noting that false gods lack even the basic capacity for self-p preservation, let alone intercession. It serves as a critique of the polytheists' reliance on intermediaries who are themselves subservient to Allah's will, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid al-Uluhiyyah.
